theme: Splitting an order so no supplier can hold you up
title: Second Source, First Timed
strategies: three-way blind split: divide every period's order across suppliers 0/1/2 without qualifying 1 or 2, wasting two-thirds of every order and forfeiting most of the volume discount

cost-minimal single-sourcing: always award the whole order to the cheapest already-qualified supplier for the deepest discount tier, never qualify a second source, never look at the disruption calendar

insurance-timed diversification: keep single-sourcing the cheapest supplier by default, but evaluate every different-correlation-group candidate's net qualification payoff (recovered value on the periods that would otherwise be lost, minus the one-time qualification cost) and buy the option that pays for itself, qualified early enough to be ready before its own group's disruption window opens
